title: finding(app-shell): RepeaterField's grid layout calls FieldControl directly, so none of the five widget detectors runs for grid cells — `detectSecretWidget` included
body:
`RepeaterField`'s **grid/table** layout renders each cell with `FieldControl` directly, so **none of the five widget detectors runs** for grid cells — while the **card** layout of the very same component runs all five. ⚠️ One of the five is `detectSecretWidget`, so a repeater that opts into `widget: 'grid'` **silently loses secret masking**.

Surfaced by the `os-dev` measuring objectui#9830 (it hit the CARD layout on its way to `action.params`) and **re-measured at source by the filing seat** on `origin/main` `5365b4c3` at 2026-09-18T11:35Z. ⛔ Not inside objectui#9830's fence; that card is a measurement and was released on a falsified premise.

## The fact, read as a block

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`.

**All five detectors are called in exactly one place — inside `FieldRow`, at `:1295`–`:1307`, behind `if (!fieldSpec?.widget)`:**

```ts
:1291  let widget = inferWidget(fieldSpec, schema);
:1294  if (!fieldSpec?.widget) {
:1295    const refWidget = detectFieldRefWidget(name, schema, widgetContext);
:1298      const secretWidget = detectSecretWidget(name, schema);
:1301        const iconWidget = detectIconWidget(name, schema);
:1304          const colorWidget = detectColorWidget(name, schema);
:1307            const condWidget = detectConditionWidget(name, schema);
```

**`RepeaterField` has two layouts, and only one of them goes through `FieldRow`:**

```ts
:2066  const useGrid = widget === 'grid' || widget === 'table';
:2097  if (useGrid) {
:2141      <FieldControl
:2151        widget={inferWidget(s, sub)}      // ⛔ inferWidget ALONE — no detector runs
:2218    <FieldRow                              // the CARD layout — all five run
```

⇒ `inferWidget` is the **only** widget decision a grid cell gets. `detectFieldRefWidget`, `detectSecretWidget`, `detectIconWidget`, `detectColorWidget` and `detectConditionWidget` are all skipped.

**Control, same instrument, same run:** a search for those five detector names across this file returns their five definitions (`:306`, `:344`, `:360`, `:591`, `:611`) and exactly five call sites, all in the `:1295`–`:1307` chain. ⇒ ⛔ there is no second call site the grid branch could be reaching instead.

## ⚠️ Why the secret one is the sharp end

`detectSecretWidget` (`:611`) is what turns a credential-shaped property into a masked control. In the card layout it runs; in the grid layout it does not. ⇒ the same repeater, the same property, the same data — **masked or not depending on a layout flag**. ⛔ Silent: no warning, no diagnostic, no degradation the author can see.

⚠️ **Stated as a shape, ⛔ not as an incident:** the filing seat did ⛔ **not** measure any shipped form spec that both declares `widget: 'grid'` **and** carries a secret-shaped property. ⇒ whether a live surface is affected today is **unmeasured**, and that is the first thing whoever takes this should settle — it is the difference between a latent asymmetry and a live exposure.

## Why the asymmetry is plausible rather than obviously a bug

A grid row has no `<label>` — the file says so at `:2143-2144`, citing objectui#5063 — so the grid branch was written to hand `FieldControl` an aria-labelledby channel instead. ⇒ it is a **deliberately different render path**, and the detector chain simply never followed it. ⛔ That makes this a gap rather than a regression, and it is why the fix shape is a real question: lift the detector chain out of `FieldRow` so both paths share it, or route grid cells through something that already calls it.

## Dedupe words

- `RepeaterField` grid layout bypasses `FieldRow`
- `FieldControl` called directly, detectors skipped
- `widget: 'grid'` loses `detectSecretWidget`
- repeater cell widget detection
- `inferWidget` alone in the grid branch
